1. Connect to your modem's Wi-Fi network:
Look for a Wi-Fi network named something like "SKYWORTH_XXXX" (where XXXX is a series of numbers).
Connect to this network using your device's Wi-Fi settings.
2. Open a web browser:
On your connected device, open a web browser (like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge).
3. Enter your modem's IP address:
In the address bar of your web browser, type the IP address of your SKYWORTH modem. This is usually found on a sticker on the bottom or back of the modem. It might look something like 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1.
Press Enter.
4. Log in to your modem's web interface:
You'll be prompted to enter a username and password. These are usually printed on the same sticker where you found the IP address. If you haven't changed them, the default username and password are likely "admin" or "user" for the username and "admin" for the password.
Enter the correct credentials and click "Login" or "Submit."
5. Navigate to the Wi-Fi settings:
Once logged in, look for a section labeled "Wireless" or "Wi-Fi." This might be under a "Setup" or "Basic Setup" tab.
Click on it to access the Wi-Fi settings.
6. Change the SSID (Wi-Fi name):
Locate the field labeled "SSID" or "Wireless Network Name."
Delete the current name and enter your desired Wi-Fi name.
Click "Save" or "Apply."
7. Change the Wi-Fi password:
Find the field labeled "Password" or "Wireless Password."
Enter your desired Wi-Fi password. Make sure it's strong and easy to remember.
Click "Save" or "Apply."
8. Reconnect to your Wi-Fi network:
After saving the changes, you'll need to reconnect to your Wi-Fi network using the new name and password.

A. Delayed or Slow Loading of EPGs
In some cases, the EPG takes longer time to load. You may opt to reset your digibox by simply unplugging it from the wall outlet. Wait for about 30 seconds and plug it back in. Allow your digibox to reboot. If EPG loading problems continue, please rescan your digibox. It is possible that your digibox isn't receiving the proper signals needed to populate it.
B. Missing EPGs
There are certain channels that display a “no program information” message. This occurs when the EPG schedules are not readily available from our channel partners. We continue to approach them, as well as other broadcasters, to supply us with any missing EPG data.
C. Incorrect EPGs
Due to the extended programming of some shows, such as live TV events, specials, live sports, and breaking news, EPG schedule changes are not always administered real-time. This transfer of information requires time to process from our end.

We try to maintain the EPG schedules as accurate as possible.

TYPE: Mesh AP Pairing -  Method 1. SKYFiber APP
DETAILS:
Step 1：Connect mobile phone to the Mesh router's Wi-Fi
Step 2：Run the APP - SKYFiber MESH
Step 3：Tap on Menu > Mesh Controller> “Join Mesh”, then tap on icon 
Step 4：1.  Scan the Serial Number of the QR code located at the back of Mesh AP beside LAN 1.
              2.  You can also manually input the Serial Number located at the bottom sticker of the Mesh AP

Press WPS button on the Controller router for 3 seconds and release, PAIR indicator will start blink in medium speed (0.5s on/0.5s off)

Press WPS button on a Agent router for 3 seconds (until PAIR indicator flash )

Please wait for about 2 minutes the Agent router will connect to the Mesh Controller automatically

Once Agent router successfully connected with the Controller,  the slave router's PAIR indicator shall become solid green
